what: This hub or motor bench exposes the port-to-motion relationship with a small mechanism. Drive a motor and measure its encoder through a Technic hub.
try: Reset and load the example when available.
Stop the program and operate one motor slider at a low setting.
Compare direction, speed and the response after Stop.
why: A motor command acts through the supported port and mechanism. Motor families differ in feedback: encoder-equipped motors can report angle and hold a target; an encoderless motor cannot gain that feedback merely from a program.
matters: Understanding the port boundary helps compare LEGO hub generations honestly.
question: Can software alone turn an encoderless motor into a measured position servo?
answer: No. A position loop needs a position measurement or another suitable feedback source.
further: Identify the motor and hub used by this model.
Compare its controls with the SPIKE survey rover.
